adaptations.samples/ControlCatalog.Browser/EmbedSamp: Do not append the asynchronously imported button after navigation has already disposed its JavaScript parent handle.
adaptations.samples/ControlCatalog/Pages/CalendarDat: Resolve the declared MainWindowViewModel from the catalog shell; the navigation content template otherwise supplies a NavigationPage data context and breaks the compiled validation-date binding.
